title: IAM and IAM Identity Center service basics
learningNotes: IAM governs AWS permissions; IAM Identity Center manages workforce sign-in and account access.
decisionCue: IAM governs AWS permissions; IAM Identity Center manages workforce sign-in and account access.

title: Amazon Security Lake service basics
learningNotes: Security Lake centralizes supported security telemetry as data; it does not investigate or alert on its own.
decisionCue: Security Lake centralizes supported security telemetry as data; it does not investigate or alert on its own.

title: AWS KMS and Secrets Manager service basics
learningNotes: Use KMS to manage encryption keys and Secrets Manager to store, retrieve, and rotate secrets.
decisionCue: Use KMS to manage encryption keys and Secrets Manager to store, retrieve, and rotate secrets.

title: Amazon Route 53 service basics
learningNotes: Route 53 answers DNS queries; application traffic goes directly to the selected endpoint.

title: Amazon EC2 service basics
learningNotes: Choose EC2 when your workload needs a virtual server and guest OS control.
